column3: A code install's consent and pin come from its verified tarball: the market fetches it within the bundle caps, checks the sha512 dist.integrity, reads permissions from package/package.json, and records { integrity, tarball, permissions } as the pending spec's pin; plugin sync verifies the tarball bytes before bun add and refuses a bun.lock SRI or an installed package.json permission outside the pin
column4: npm does not tie the version document to the tarball (manifest confusion), so permissions read from metadata could differ from what builds
column5: review of xin#35 at 6c940ee (XIN-23); test 'reads a code package's permissions from its verified tarball' fails on the old market
